subject: general
question: The HCF and the LCM of two numbers are 11 and 330, respectively. If one of the numbers is 66, find the other one.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Product of **LCM** × **HCF** = Product of **Two Numbers**

330 × 11 = 66 × Second Number

Second Number = (330 × 11) ÷ 66 = 330 ÷ 6 = 55

**∴ The correct answer is 55.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**HCF** of two numbers = 11

**LCM** of two numbers = 330

One number (**n₁**) = 66

**Formula Used:**

**n₁ × n₂ = HCF × LCM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98415eb0212b73877cb3088d2881d822ed53463a09e28072e6cbe354dcf70f0e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 66 × n₂ = 11 × 330

⇒ n₂ = (11 × 330) ÷ 66

⇒ n₂ = 3630 ÷ 66

⇒ n₂ = 55

**∴ The correct answer is 55.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF (Highest Common Factor)

The greatest number that divides two or more numbers without leaving a remainder.

LCM (Least Common Multiple)

The smallest non-zero number that is a multiple of two or more numbers.

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are co-prime if their **HCF** is 1. For co-prime numbers, **LCM** = Product of the numbers.</p
